purpose: Explore image candidates; not evaluation personas, demographic targeting rules, or measured preferences.
selectionPolicy: none; image selection and model integration are intentionally not implemented by this fixture

personas.label: Campus student
personas.goal: Find practical things for classes, study breaks and carrying lunch.
questionsToTest: Does a clear product view explain the item better than a campus scene?
Are portability cues useful without implying unverified capacity?

personas.label: Focused commuter
personas.goal: Make a daily trip to work and desk time more comfortable.
questionsToTest: Which composition makes size and construction easiest to understand?
Does a workspace scene add useful context?

personas.label: Family outing organizer
personas.goal: Pack everyday essentials for a market trip or afternoon in the park.
questionsToTest: Does showing an item in use help explain how it might fit into a day out?
Is the empty product view more useful for judging shape?

personas.label: Weekend wanderer
personas.goal: Find versatile things for short walks, picnics and time outside.
questionsToTest: Does a detail view communicate material better than a broad setting?
Does an outdoor scene help this shopping task?

personas.label: Remote worker
personas.goal: Make a small home workspace comfortable for focused work and reading.
questionsToTest: Does a warm or neutral treatment make product details clearer?
Does showing scale relative to a desk help?

personas.label: Active routine shopper
personas.goal: Find simple everyday items for exercise, swimming and breaks outside.
questionsToTest: Is shape and material easier to judge in studio or in use?
Does a close crop hide information this shopper needs?

personas.label: Everyday walker
personas.goal: Find casual items for errands and neighborhood walks.
questionsToTest: Does the wearer photo explain scale or simply add distraction?
Which angle best shows the shoe's construction?

personas.label: Quiet homebody
personas.goal: Choose useful things for reading and relaxing at home.
questionsToTest: Is material texture more useful than room atmosphere?
Would a plain view make comparison easier?

personas.label: Light traveler
personas.goal: Organize a few essentials for short trips by train.
questionsToTest: Does an in-use image help communicate scale?
Would less visual context make the travel bag easier to inspect?

personas.label: City explorer
personas.goal: Find flexible accessories for walking, cafes and errands.
questionsToTest: Does seeing an accessory worn help this decision?
Does lighting alter how accurately color can be judged?

personas.label: Creative hobbyist
personas.goal: Keep drawing and note-taking essentials close at hand.
questionsToTest: Would a detail, plain view or working scene communicate the most useful information?
Does a textured background improve or reduce legibility of the product?
